floors.name: What a Program Is
floors.goal: Run a Python program, read its output, and say what the interpreter did with the source.

floors.name: Values and Names
floors.goal: Store a value under a name, inspect its type, and predict what a name refers to.

floors.name: Expressions
floors.goal: Evaluate an expression by hand and predict its type and value before running it.

floors.name: Decisions
floors.goal: Direct a program down different paths using conditions, and predict which path runs.

floors.name: Repetition
floors.goal: Repeat work with loops, and choose between counting, accumulating and searching.

floors.name: Reading Failure
floors.goal: Read a traceback, locate the failing line, and isolate a fault without guessing.

floors.name: Functions
floors.goal: Package behaviour behind a name with parameters and a return value.

floors.name: Decomposition
floors.goal: Break a stated problem into functions before writing any of them.

floors.name: Text
floors.goal: Manipulate text by index, slice and method, and know why strings cannot be edited in place.

floors.name: Lists
floors.goal: Build and modify sequences, and tell aliasing from copying.

floors.name: Dictionaries and Sets
floors.goal: Look things up by key and test membership without scanning.

floors.name: Choosing a Container
floors.goal: Pick the right structure for a stated problem and defend it against the alternative.

floors.name: Comprehensions
floors.goal: Transform a collection in one readable expression, and know when not to.

floors.name: Files
floors.goal: Read and write files safely, handling paths and encodings.

floors.name: Errors as Control Flow
floors.goal: Raise, catch and design exceptions, and decide what must not be caught.

floors.name: Modules
floors.goal: Split a program across files and control what each exposes.

floors.name: The Standard Library
floors.goal: Find and use a module you have never seen, from its documentation.

floors.name: Classes
floors.goal: Model state and behaviour together, and judge when a class is the wrong answer.

floors.name: Cost
floors.goal: Predict how a program's running time grows, and choose on measured evidence.

floors.name: Iterators and Generators
floors.goal: Produce values lazily, and process data larger than memory.

floors.name: Closures and Decorators
floors.goal: Treat functions as values, and wrap behaviour without editing it.

floors.name: Type Annotations
floors.goal: Express a contract in types and use a checker to enforce it.

floors.name: Testing
floors.goal: Write a failing test first, then the code that satisfies it.

floors.name: Talking to the Outside
floors.goal: Consume an HTTP/JSON interface and survive its failures.

floors.name: Concurrency
floors.goal: Choose between threads, processes and async for a stated workload.

floors.name: Version Control
floors.goal: Read a repository's history as evidence, and find when a behaviour changed.

floors.name: Projects and Dependencies
floors.goal: Lay out a project, isolate its environment, and pin what it depends on.

floors.name: Reading Unfamiliar Code
floors.goal: Build a working mental model of code you did not write.

floors.name: Refactoring Under Tests
floors.goal: Change the shape of working code without changing what it does.

floors.name: Professional Debugging
floors.goal: Reproduce, isolate and fix a defect in a system you do not fully understand.

floors.name: The Trial of the Inherited Repository
floors.goal: Take ownership of an unfamiliar Python codebase, diagnose a reported defect, fix it under test, and justify the change.
